description: Set top, want, maybe, skip, seen or declined for a film (use the filmId from list_releases) using existing rules. The returned plan names both ids (filmId and amcMovieId). Top is only for films whose tickets are locked in: booked Top tickets are never released, cancelled, swapped or unprotected by any agent or automation, and a Top film with an upcoming locked ticket can't be moved out of Top (409 locked_top_ticket). Use want for anything you'd like to see. Does not create a booking request.

filmId.description: Use the filmId from list_releases (the AMC movie id); the planner's own film id from get_plan works too.
